identity.description: Recomputes four transparent derived features from source fields: yield momentum (trend × volatility), market-cap/TVL ratio, risk score (beta × vol / Sharpe), and yield premium (asset vs category). Every output includes formula inputs so results are fully auditable.

capabilities.dataCoverage: 4 derived features computed for all 59 assets, formula inputs exposed in every output

inputs.description: Feature request with optional source and asset filters.

outputs.description: Derived feature values with formula inputs, warnings for undefined ratios, and evidence locations.

mustNot: silently replace undefined divisions with zero
present derived features as validated investment signals
skill.userValue: Use transparent derived features as reproducible research inputs. Check units, missing denominators, outliers, and chronological leakage before using a feature in a model.
